import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Fix sex case variant (FEMALE -> female)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    # Fix body_mass_g: remove commas and convert to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
    
    # Fix negative flipper_length_mm (take absolute value)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    
    # Remove out-of-range body_mass_g values (3700000 is clearly invalid)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)].reset_index(drop=True)
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().to_dict()
    return result
